bull.b: Improving revenue quality through higher-value T-Rex and Balance products can support gross-margin resilience and strengthen unit economics. Greater premium adoption also gives Zepp more room to invest in product development and brand building while reducing reliance on entry-level volume.

A broader software ecosystem can deepen user engagement and make Amazfit devices more differentiated than hardware-only alternatives. As features span more products, the platform may support stronger retention, reinforce brand loyalty, and improve the durability of future device demand.

Stronger regional value share and a global HYROX partnership expand Amazfit’s visibility in performance training and create durable channels for product validation. These developments can improve brand credibility, support customer acquisition, and broaden the company’s competitive position.

bear.b: Continued losses show that revenue growth has not yet translated into sustainable earnings. Ongoing operating deficits can constrain investment flexibility, weaken resilience during product or demand changes, and leave the planned return to profitable growth dependent on successful execution.

Repeatedly negative operating and free cash flow indicate that the business has not consistently funded itself through operations. If losses persist, Zepp may need to rely on existing liquidity or other balance-sheet support, limiting its ability to invest and absorb setbacks.

Debt exceeding equity increases financial obligations while profitability remains weak, reducing flexibility for product investment and strategic initiatives. The rising leverage trend can also make future funding more consequential if cash generation does not improve over the coming periods.
